kicker.zh: 型号 / 接口 / 材料

intro.en: Find a cable model or material part number, then send it for a custom replacement or original-part sourcing review.
intro.zh: 按成品型号或材料料号查找，提交编号即可沟通兼容替代件制作或原厂件采购。

search_label.en: Find a model or part number

search_placeholder.en: Brand, model, part number or product type
search_placeholder.zh: 输入品牌、型号、料号或产品类型

empty.en: No matching references. Try a brand, full part number or a listed alias.
empty.zh: 未找到匹配项，请尝试品牌、完整料号或已列出的别名。

intro.en: Manufacturer-identified finished assemblies for this application.
intro.zh: 此应用范围内经原厂资料核验的成品组件。

intro.en: Category-specific material references; the final BOM follows the approved configuration.
intro.zh: 此类选型的材料参考；最终 BOM 以确认配置为准。

copy.en: A trailer harness is not one universal cable. Connector family, regional interface, system voltage, circuit count, trailer length, axle and brake architecture, installed equipment and exposure determine the released design. A plug that mates mechanically does not prove pin assignment, current capacity, grounding, network compatibility or environmental performance.
copy.zh: 拖车线束不是一根通用电缆。连接器家族、地区接口、系统电压、回路数量、拖车长度、车轴与制动架构、安装设备及暴露环境共同决定放行设计。插头能够机械插合，并不能证明针脚定义、载流能力、接地、网络兼容性或环境性能。

copy.en: Provide towing vehicle and trailer type; market and applicable interface standard; system voltage; connector and mating-part data; circuit table and loads; lighting, brake, ABS/EBS and auxiliary equipment; trailer length, axle count and articulation points; chassis route photographs; clips and pass-throughs; water, salt, mud, UV and washdown exposure; drawings or sample; labels; quantity; and required validation.
copy.zh: 请提供牵引车与拖车类型、销售市场及适用接口标准、系统电压、连接器与对插件资料、回路表与负载、灯光、制动、ABS/EBS 及辅助设备信息、拖车长度、车轴数量与铰接点、底盘走线照片、卡扣与穿孔、水、盐、泥浆、紫外线及冲洗暴露、图纸或样品、标签、数量与所需验证。

copy.en: Approved requirements become controlled drawings, circuit and pin tables, BOMs, cut lists, splice maps, route datums, protection instructions, labels and test programs. First articles are checked for mating, reach, articulation, chassis clearance, lamp and equipment function and agreed vehicle behavior before repeat production. Records remain linked to trailer configuration and drawing revision.
copy.zh: 批准需求会转化为受控图纸、回路与针脚表、物料表、裁线表、接续图、走线基准、防护工艺、标签与测试程序。重复生产前检查首件的对插、可达、铰接、底盘间隙、灯具与设备功能及约定车辆行为，记录持续关联拖车配置和图纸版本。

copy.en: Confirm the exact mating interface, pin map, dimensions and installation orientation.
copy.zh: 确认准确对插接口、针脚对应、尺寸及安装方向。

copy.en: Agree the sample configuration and electrical, mechanical or environmental checks required by the project.
copy.zh: 约定样品配置以及项目所需的电气、机械或环境检查。

copy.en: Record changes to materials, drawings and process instructions before repeat manufacture.
copy.zh: 重复制造前记录材料、图纸与工艺说明的变更。

boundary.en: Send the part number, drawing or sample to confirm the replacement configuration and sourcing plan.
boundary.zh: 请提供型号、图纸或样品，具体替代配置与原厂件采购方案按项目确认。

text.en: Send the model or part number to discuss your project.
text.zh: 提交型号或料号，沟通您的定制与采购需求。

service_label.zh: 可制作兼容替代件、自有原厂采购渠道

reason.en: Application-specific references are shown at their audited counts. Materials require their own category evidence and are not assumed to be the BOM of every listed assembly.
reason.zh: 应用专用编号按核验的实际数量展示；材料须有独立类别依据，不将其视为每件成品的通用 BOM。
